SELECT DISTINCT condition FROM measurements LIMIT 10;

SELECT m.session_id, m.participant_id, m.condition, m.cognitive_score, m.reaction_ms, m.recorded_at, m.status, m.notes
FROM measurements m
INNER JOIN (
    SELECT session_id, MAX(recorded_at) as max_recorded_at
    FROM measurements
    GROUP BY session_id
) latest ON m.session_id = latest.session_id AND m.recorded_at = latest.max_recorded_at
ORDER BY m.recorded_at DESC
